kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يعصوصب (form XII)
# يَعْصَوْصِبُ (yaʕṣawṣibu) /jaʕ.sˤaw.sˤi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
# يَعْصَوْصِبَ (yaʕṣawṣiba) /jaʕ.sˤaw.sˤi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
# يَعْصَوْصِبْ (yaʕṣawṣib) /jaʕ.sˤaw.sˤib/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِعْصَوْصَ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
